purpose: Teach: 履き/怪しげ/一人前/ありゃ/競う/似合わ/着々と/とてつもなく

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、新しい靴を履きましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's get those new shoes on, shall we?
lines.style: Warm, practical instruction. Gentle but purposeful. The slight lilt on 'shall we' is maternal — inviting him to participate rather than simply comply.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、外に怪しげな人がいなかったよ
lines.en: Mom, there wasn't anyone suspicious outside today.
lines.style: Quiet, matter-of-fact observation. No alarm — just reporting something he noticed. Small pause before speaking, like he's processed it himself first.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「翔くんも、一人前のお手伝いができるね」って
lines.en: Sho, your dad said something — that you're becoming quite capable at helping out around here.
lines.style: Pleased warmth. Light, affirming tone. Speaks as though sharing something special. Slight emphasis on 'quite capable' — genuinely proud.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ありゃ、お祖父ちゃんからお手紙届いたよ
lines.en: Mom, oh — Grandpa sent a letter!
lines.style: Sudden brightness breaking through. Quick uptake on the realization. Genuine excitement, not performed — he's genuinely delighted by the news.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達と競う事も成長になるわよ
lines.en: Sho, competing with your friends — that's part of growing too, you know.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured. She's offering perspective gently, not lecturing. The 'you know' is soft, inviting understanding rather than imposing it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、この帽子、ぼくに似合わないよね
lines.en: Mom, this hat doesn't really suit me, does it?
lines.style: Small, self-aware humor. Slightly hesitant — genuinely asking for reassurance but wrapped in gentle self-deprecation. The upturn at the end seeks agreement.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お家の整理整頓、着々と進んでるわね
lines.en: Sho, the house is really coming together nicely. Look at all this progress.
lines.style: Pleased observation. Warm acknowledgment of effort. Slow, appreciative — she's noticing and naming what he's doing without overdoing the praise.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんから、とてつもなく大きなおもちゃもらったよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa gave me something incredible — it's absolutely huge!
lines.style: Genuine wonder and excitement building to the finale. Breathless with the size of it. The final phrase tumbles out with pure joy — no containment, just honest delight.
